modes.A: dispatcher top-1 segmentation, top-1 world per piece, original text, rules only (no interpreter)
modes.B: beam 4, top-3 worlds, original text, rules + interpreter validation (strict)
modes.C: B plus simplified text (equal to B when no piece has simplified)
modes.Br: B with acceptRefused (a complete parse the interpreter refuses counts as understood)
modes.Bf: B, then the rules-over-all-worlds result (R) when B says not_understood
modes.Brf: Br, then R when Br says not_understood
modes.R: rules only: the whole message through the dialog session over all worlds (current router), no dispatcher

definitions.exact_sop: concatenation (message order) of id-normalized SOP of produced pieces equals the concatenation of id-normalized SOP of each gold segment target; negative: result is not_understood
definitions.understanding: right = exact SOP; fallback = not_understood (R: a segment unparsed or nothing parsed); wrong = understood but another SOP
definitions.segmentation_match: same number of pieces, every piece overlaps its gold segment with character IoU >= 0.6
definitions.recovery: recoverable = top-1 segmentation right, some piece has the gold world not first but within top 3; wrong_top1_rejected = every such piece top-1 candidate fails validation; recovered_exact = exact SOP (per policy B and Br)
definitions.failure_classes: failures of Br: segmentation wrong (no beam entry matches) > world not in candidates (gold world of a piece not in top 3) > rule gap (rules of the gold world do not parse the piece) > interpreter rejects correct parse > wrong reading chosen (gold reading valid but another won) > sop differs (gold world and segmentation chosen, circuits differ)

headline.definition: share of realistic positive messages (paraphrase test, held-out, multi-command) whose final result is: right = exact SOP, fallback = "not understood / Did you mean ...?", wrong = understood with another SOP. R = rules only (current router), B = dispatcher top-3 + validation (strict), Br = same with acceptRefused (lead policy); Bf / Brf = B / Br followed by the engine fallback (a not-understood message is retried with the rules over all worlds = R; whole-message approximation of the per-piece retry of spec 03 section 7.7)
